rationale.oversight-explanation: Interactive views expose agent plans, code evolution, logs, and behavior.
rationale.rules-based-checks: AST normalization and execution outcomes deterministically reveal code differences and bugs.
rationale.quality-debt: Case studies uncover recurring bugs, redundant code, and wasted computation.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented a coordinated four-view visual analytics system.
rationale.expert-validated: Five experienced ML scientists assessed usefulness through guided case studies.
rationale.agentic: Studied agents autonomously iterate and deliver complete code solutions.
rationale.metrics: Defines quality measurands through function-level similarity and buggy-node ratios.
rationale.routing-signal: Similarity clustering and ordering direct attention toward representative or anomalous runs.
rationale.risk-quality: Empirically analyzes bugs, functional duplication, robustness, and resource waste.
rationale.method-self-report: Expert requirements, think-aloud observations, and feedback supply qualitative evidence.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled repeated AIDE runs compare five LLMs on identical tasks.
